card.name: Words linking a share to its cause
card.fires_on: Words that sit just before a cause or attribution is stated, such as 'of' after a percentage, 'to' in 'due to', 'able' in 'preventable', and 'attributed'. Seen in health statistics and adverse-event text.

modes.label: Percent of cases
modes.description: The word 'of' after a percentage, before the disease or cancers it is attributed to.

modes.description: The ending 'able' in 'preventable' when speaking of deaths or incidents.

modes.description: Linking words in adverse-event reports that tie an event to a cause or a rating.
